content.subject: Quick thought on ShipBob’s new connector
content.draft_text:
Hi Test,

I'm Zamp from Zamp Technologies. We help operations teams automate manual, reconciliation-heavy processes.

Saw that ShipBob launched its first Anthropic-verified fulfillment connector, anchoring its AI suite. I imagine keeping fulfillment data aligned across systems can become increasingly time-consuming.

We extract data from fulfillment logs and reconcile it against inventory records, reducing repetitive manual checks.

Curious if this is something you're thinking about right now? Happy to connect for a quick chat.

Best,
Zamp
